phase1.explanation:
🦀 **Traits define shared behavior across types.**

**Trait features:**

| Feature | Example |
|---------|---------|
| Definition | `trait Attackable { fn attack(&self); }` |
| Implementation | `impl Attackable for Player { ... }` |
| Default methods | `fn print(&self) { ... }` |
| Generic bounds | `impl<T: Attackable> ...` |

**Rust-chan says:**
"Traits are like interfaces, but more powerful. They define what types can do."

**When to use traits:**
| Situation | Use traits |
|-----------|-----------|
| Shared behavior | ✅ |
| Polymorphism | ✅ |
| Testing | ✅ |
| Generic code | ✅ |
